assessment_basis: Static review of the repository README and linked feature, architecture or roadmap documentation. Source-level deep audit and CI/test rerun were not performed for this adoption.

evidence.claim: Experimental x86_64 Stage 1 boot and Reaper policy contracts are distinguished from missing process, syscall, driver, storage and compositor services.
The native implementation sequence records delivered, partial and planned boundaries with boot/CI evidence links.

limitations: The experimental Stage 1 kernel is not a usable process/service OS session.
No test or CI workflow was re-run during ladder adoption.
next_gate: Deliver and test additional native kernel/runtime primitives beyond the Stage 1 boot slice.

Update implementation status with exact source, test and CI evidence.
